thread:
Claire H: Scheduling a small catalog update — want to add Fordham-2b (q4f) into the lite slot tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Who can own the handshake + smoke?
Raj P: I can take the canary + smoke runs. What manifest/artifact should I pin to?
Claire H: Manifest: mf-20260315-ff2a7c. Quant variant: q4f-int8. Model hash: 9b7d3e. Route alias will be `fordham-2b-lite`.
Samir: Quick CR ping — I left one comment on the catalog PR about the default batch config. Can someone address before pin?
Ivy T: I’ll review the PR now (ETA 30m). If it’s just batch defaults I can approve unless it changes perf knobs.
Ben Ops: Heads up — ops checklist: reserve slot on staging, confirm autoscaler min=1, warm caches, set rollback alias ready. I’ll own the slot reservation.
deploy-bot: ci/cd pipeline passed: catalog-pr/578 — checks: lint ✅, unit-tests ✅, integration-smoke ✅, manifest-verify ✅. (link: https://ci.redwood/example/578)
Raj P: Got the manifest. Plan: deploy canary at 16:00 UTC to 5% traffic (lite slot). Run smoke: 1) basic generation sanity 2) latency profile 3) eval prompts (subset). Expected p90 latency <220ms.
Nadia S: For smoke prompts, use the `catalog/smoke/fordham-lite.yaml` set — includes perf and quality checks. I’ll kick off eval harness.
Claire H: Great. Rollback plan: if latency p90 >250ms or quality regressions on any critical prompt, immediate rollback and pin previous alias `fordham-2b-stable`. Ben, do you have the command to flip it?
Ben Ops: Yep — rollback CLI:```bash
rwctl catalog alias swap --from fordham-2b-lite --to fordham-2b-stable --force
```Will test in dry-run before 16:00. Also setting an automated fallback in the routing policy for 10m.
Samir: FYI I updated batch defaults to `max_batch_tokens: 4096, batch_timeout_ms: 8` — should reduce latency for short chats. Noted in PR comment.
Ivy T: PR approved and merged. Tagging the release: `catalog-release-2026-03-15`.
Raj P: Starting canary rollout now (16:00 UTC). I’ll post updates.
Raj P: Canary smoke results: sanity OK, p50 115ms, p90 201ms, memory within expected. Eval: no critical regressions; a minor drop on prompt #12 (-0.4 BLEU) but below alert threshold.
Claire H: Nice. Let’s ramp to 25% after 30m if stable. Raj, Nadia — please monitor for 60m and report any anomalies here. :thumbsup:
Ivy T: Noted, will keep dashboard open and watch traces.
Ben Ops: Slot warm, autoscaler healthy. I’ve prepared rollback token in case.
Raj P: Will roll to 25% at 16:30 UTC, will post final pin if everything stays green.
Nadia S: Eval harness ran continuous checks, all green so far.
Raj P: Final: ramped to 25% and pinned alias `fordham-2b-lite` to mf-20260315-ff2a7c at 17:05 UTC. No rollback needed. Closing the handshake.
Claire H: Thanks all — adding a short postmortem note in the deploy doc and updating the catalog slot ownership. :rocket:
